newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - heating oil falls, naphtha up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - heating oil falls, naphtha up.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday, but heating oil fell on growing U.S. stocks.
Gasoline cargoes were firmer with buying interest into the U.K., France and Poland, but barges were weaker.
Naphtha was stronger with uncovered demand for paraffinic grades. A trader was bidding for a cargo at $229 cif NWE.
Heating oil eased after U.S. data showed an unexpected build in stocks last week, but diesel demand remained very strong.
Fuel oil was slow as dealers came to terms with prices that keep edging up. Barges were thinly traded at $123 fob ARA.
